Weapon Proficiency: Arsenal

Hijutsu: Buki Senmon  |  Type: Restricted Aptitudes & Abilities  |  Source: Hijutsu Vol. 2, PDF p. 24

Rules from the translated book

PERFECT ACUITY
You are able to use your dexterity to wield and inflict damage with
weapons.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 8; Finesse; Weapon Proficiency: Arsenal.

Benefit: You are able to use Dexterity to meet the attribute prerequisites for
using any weapon.

You consider all weapons to be "Accurate Weapons" (they can be used with
the accuracy skill).

Additionally, whenever you use a weapon with accuracy, you can substitute
Strength for Dexterity in the damage calculation.

COMPLETE ARSENAL
You use some kind of shinobi trick to be able to carry a full arsenal of weapons
for missions.

Prerequisites: Use Weapon: Arsenal; Create Weapon or Fuuinjutsu 2

Benefit: You are able to possess a complete arsenal with an infinite number of
non-special weapons occupying little space. How this happens is defined by
the player, whether it's a scroll containing a complete arsenal, like Tenten's, or
a container of liquid metal that molds itself to the character's will, for example.

To use this skill, you must prepare your arsenal at the start of the adventure
and choose how many slots it occupies, 1 or 2. A full 1-slot arsenal is capable
of generating an infinite number of weapons.

Possession of The White Serpent

Hijutsu: Hebinomichi  |  Type: Aptitudes & Abilities  |  Source: Hijutsu Vol. 2, PDF p. 42

Rules from the translated book

A reference to the work "Jiraiya Ore no Monogatari," where the prince was possessed
by the spirit of an evil serpent named Orochimaru, this is the name given to the
shinobi's initiation into the hidden art of snakes.
Prerequisites: Occultism 2; Spirit 2
Benefit: As an initiate in the occult art of the Serpent's Paths, you receive +1 extra
compartment, located in your stomach, in addition to increasing the number of
compartments that can be carried without penalty to 4 instead of 3.
Removing an item from your stomach, through your mouth, costs the same action
as removing it from any other compartment. Quick Draw can be used with this
compartment. It is not possible to place items that occupy more than 1 compartment
in your stomach, and the item placed there will be preserved, receiving no external
damage.

(Body Replacement Technique)”. It now only requires a partial action instead of a
movement action. This is because you “change skin,” leaving behind a hollow,
withered body while you emerge with new skin. Using Kawarimi in this way does not
allow you to move. For that, you must use the technique as a movement action,
following its normal rules.
